t: 现今的缅甸,阿瓦王国倒入了通古道王朝.
te: The Ava Kingdom falls to the Taungoo Dynasty in what is now Myanmar.
dz: 现今的缅甸,阿瓦王国倒入了通古道王朝.
de: The Ava Kingdom falls to the Taungoo Dynasty in what is now Myanmar.

t: 约翰·罗杰斯被活活活烧死,成为玛丽一世女王统治下的第一个英国新教殉道者.
te: John Rogers is burned at the stake, becoming the first English Protestant martyr under Queen Mary I.
dz: 约翰·罗杰斯被活活活烧死,成为玛丽一世女王统治下的第一个英国新教殉道者.
de: John Rogers is burned at the stake, becoming the first English Protestant martyr under Queen Mary I.

t: 格洛斯特·约翰·胡珀的主教被活活烧死.
te: Bishop of Gloucester John Hooper is burned at the stake.
dz: 格洛斯特·约翰·胡珀的主教被活活烧死.

t: 奥斯曼帝国和萨法维帝国签署和平条约，结束 1532-1555 年的奥斯曼-萨法维战争。
te: The Ottoman Empire and the Safavid Empire sign a peace treaty to end the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1532–1555.
dz: 奥斯曼帝国和萨法维帝国签署和平条约，结束 1532-1555 年的奥斯曼-萨法维战争。

t: 胡马云和拜拉姆汗所领导的莫卧儿军队在锡干达尔·沙阿·苏里所领导的阿富汗军队在锡尔欣德战役中被击…
te: A Mughal army under Humayun and Bairam Khan defeats an Afghan army under Sikandar Shah Suri in the battle of Sirhind, a…
dz: 胡马云和拜拉姆汗所领导的莫卧儿军队在锡干达尔·沙阿·苏里所领导的阿富汗军队在锡尔欣德战役中被击败,使胡马云能攻克德里并在印度重建莫卧儿帝国.
de: A Mughal army under Humayun and Bairam Khan defeats an Afghan army under Sikandar Shah Suri in the battle of Sirhind, allowing Humayun to capture Delhi and reestablish the Mughal Empire in India.

t: 军火学院由英国女王玛丽一世和西班牙国王腓力二世签署的皇家宪章重新组建.
te: The College of Arms is reincorporated by Royal charter signed by Queen Mary I of England and King Philip II of Spain.
dz: 军火学院由英国女王玛丽一世和西班牙国王腓力二世签署的皇家宪章重新组建.
de: The College of Arms is reincorporated by Royal charter signed by Queen Mary I of England and King Philip II of Spain.

t: 奥格斯堡和平由皇帝查理五世和施马尔卡尔德克联盟的王子们签署.
te: The Peace of Augsburg is signed by Emperor Charles V and the princes of the Schmalkaldic League.
dz: 奥格斯堡和平由皇帝查理五世和施马尔卡尔德克联盟的王子们签署.

t: 法国人胡盖诺茨在巴西现今的里约热内卢建立了法国Antarctique殖民地.
te: French Huguenots establish the France Antarctique colony in present-day Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
